flags.message: The snapshot links lower-court orders/opinions, but only application.txt was provisioned. The injunction's wording and the state appellate posture were assessed through the applicants' quotations and account, not independent lower-court text. The response is not due until September 28 and its absence is expected. Forecast completed with reduced confidence; provisioned appendix text would materially improve review.

corpus-info could not report corpus freshness because the cell service backend has no client-side connection. The baseline uses the committed statpack, last changed September 26, 2026, without claiming that commit time is the corpus vintage. Web precedent lookups also returned no usable content; CourtListener supplied general Nken stay-factor excerpts. No target-case outcome was retrieved.
